blocks.text: Scioto River and nearby communities in southern Ohio

Ohio University’s Scripps guide renders it ‘sigh OH tuh’; listen to local speakers too. Try it gently, then let the people who know the place guide you. I’d listen to the name before trying it aloud. It’s a lovely little moment when the letters and the sound finally meet. ♡
